label: Hua Hin
short_description: Beach resorts across the royal seaside town on the Gulf of Thailand, spanning Hua Hin and Pranburi.
intro: Hua Hin's hotels in this directory sit along the Gulf of Thailand beachfront of the long-time royal retreat about three hours southwest of Bangkok, plus the quieter Pranburi coast to the south. Calmer and more family- and golf-oriented than Thailand's island resorts, Hua Hin is reached by road or rail from Bangkok, or via its small local airport (HHQ).
